q: What protects Nova City on Mars?
explain: Giant glass domes cover the city and protect it from Mars's harsh environment.

q: How many main zones does Nova City have?
explain: There are five: Residential, Entertainment, Technology, Green and Spaceport.

q: Which zone has the landing pads for ships to Earth?
explain: The Spaceport Zone has the landing pads and control towers that link Mars and Earth.

q: AI research centers and advanced laboratories are in which zone?
explain: Intelligent buildings, AI research centers and advanced labs make up the Technology Zone.

q: What would you find in the Entertainment Zone?
explain: The Entertainment Zone has giant shopping malls, VR cinemas, high-tech amusement parks and automated restaurants.

q: Which of these belong in the Green Zone?
explain: The Green Zone has artificial forests, lakes, waterfalls and farms that grow fresh food.

q: About how many people live in Nova City?
explain: About 10 to 15 million people live there, scientists and families included.

q: Where does the city get its clean power?
explain: Solar panels and advanced batteries give the city clean, steady electricity.

q: How does each dome keep its air fresh and comfortable?
explain: Every dome has its own oxygen supply, air purification and temperature control.

q: How do people travel between the zones?
explain: High-speed magnetic trains and transport tunnels link the zones.

q: How does fresh food reach people in Nova City?
explain: Food grows in indoor farms and vertical gardens, and robots deliver it.

q: What do robots do in a Nova City home?
explain: Robots clean and do the housework, so families get more free time.

q: Why does Nova City build so many skyscrapers?
explain: Living in tall buildings saves space and keeps the natural Mars landscape outside safe.

q: What does the Central AI Brain look after?
explain: It manages the power grid so there are no blackouts, and stores extra energy so nothing is wasted.

q: How does Nova City help planet Earth?
explain: Moving millions of people to Mars means fewer crowds and fewer resources used on Earth, so it gets time to recover.
